name: @prowess/rules
description: Framework-independent, pure M4 Rules Engine foundation: the four evaluation contexts (Ruleset, Actor, Build, Runtime), the common RuleEngineResponse envelope, structured engine errors and validation messages, the calculation trace contract and rule provenance. Evaluates only exact, caller-supplied rule material — no persistence, no UI, no clock, no randomness, no network, no authored-code execution.

scripts.test:integration: echo "@prowess/rules: no integration tests (pure package)" && exit 0
